notes: Algorithm measured on AE 2026 8 bpc, straight 8-bit colour: L = 0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B in float (NOT rounded to 8 bits, unlike Tint); the three colours are used as floats (quantising them to 8 bits first breaks tritone_1 on 53 % of the pixels); out = L < 0.5 ? mix(Shadows, Midtones, 2L) : mix(Midtones, Highlights, 2L - 1); one half-up rounding at the end; alpha untouched. Double precision gives 0 mismatches on the opaque pixels; f32 leaves 1-2 exact-tie pixels (+-1). Units: colours straight 0..1 (alpha ignored, AE stores alpha 0 in the defaults), Blend With Original 0..100 % (lerp tritone -> original; no visible reference). Residuals: semi-transparent pixels (alpha 128) are +-1 because the offline input is premultiplied (straight 200 at alpha 128 comes back as 199); Rive: colours pass through fxlib.argb_hex (8-bit, Python half-to-even: 0.7 -> 178 instead of AE's float 178.5), hence tritone_1 rive mean 0.055 / max 2, plus the usual +-1 Rive composite noise.
